I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The answer is Pine Crossing.

- **Where it comes from:** Pree posted it herself in #central-team on Jun 9. The morning receiver there said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it.
- **What I couldn't find:** there's no city or address for Pine Crossing in anything Pree can see. I told her to check with store ops or Hollis's tracker if the account sheet needs more than the store name.
- **Something to be aware of:** the brain has an onboarding ticket (SUP-5102) that lists six new Marrow Agrisupply stores. Pine Crossing isn't one of them, though a "Mill Crossing" is. Pree can't see that ticket in the shared files, so I left it out of my reply. It might mean a name mix-up in the store list, but I can't confirm that.
